release_policy: Only a separately verified, user-visible capability counts. Refactors, duplicate functionality, tests, docs, and bug-fix-only commits never increase the feature count. No feature release below ten. Emergency security/data-loss fixes use a separate documented hotfix approval.

features.title: Persistent low-memory filename index
features.acceptance: After restart, filenames on accessible ready drives are searchable without a full fresh crawl; deletions and renames remain correct.

features.title: Saved searches and presets
features.acceptance: User can save, rename, select and remove an advanced query; its filters are restored without running external actions.

features.title: Unified result action menu
features.acceptance: Search result offers Open, Copy Path and Open Containing Folder with path revalidation and blocked destructive actions.

features.title: SHA-256 file verification
features.acceptance: User chooses a file, sees its SHA-256, compares optional expected digest, and receives a clear pass/fail without uploading contents.

features.title: Read-only duplicate file inspector
features.acceptance: User chooses folders and previews equal-hash duplicate groups with size/paths, without auto-deleting or modifying files.

features.title: Safe batch image conversion
features.acceptance: User selects images, previews output format and destination, converts with no-overwrite default, and can cancel safely.

features.title: Opt-in local snippets
features.acceptance: User explicitly saves, searches, pins and deletes text snippets; history capture is disabled by default and sensitive windows can be excluded.

features.title: On-demand screen text extraction
features.acceptance: User selects a region, previews local OCR and manually copies accepted text; no automatic screen reading or upload.

features.title: Verified mapping and paste preview
features.acceptance: Captured Sheet/Mappings use existing engine; preview validates target range, formulas and backup/readback before user-approved paste.

features.title: Monitor-aware session restore preview
features.acceptance: User sees a preview of apps/windows/monitor placement, reviews unavailable applications, and explicitly approves restore.

acceptance_gates: Ten distinct features each verified from their actual shipped source and integrated UI.
All historical Windows native, deck, search, updater and data-integrity regressions passing.
Three real Office workbook scenarios and real two-monitor checks for the flagged features.
No destructive operation without preview/confirmation; saved DeskSpace data remains intact.
Same SHA-256 installer on Stable and Tester; updater/rollback tests pass.
No publication from a development branch or an unverified/stale baseline.
